column2: Emotiva UMC-1 Metal Remote Codes – rev 1/25/11
Here are the current complimentary IR codes, in hex format, for your use in programmable remotes that accept hex codes. We
do not guarantee the accuracy of these codes nor their use in your particular remote. These are offered purely as a
complimentary feature of the Emotiva UMC product family. Keep in mind you may have issues with repeat counts, timings,
durations, emitter placement, etc. as you program your remote control system of choice. We offer no support for any remotes or
IR teaching/learning processes other than factory UMC remote.
